name: Harold And The Witches
source:
You take on the role of Harold Flynn, a newly qualified teacher who is about to start his first day on the job. Before he starts, he learns some extraordinary news from his mother.  Join Harold in a fictional world where witches are not the only ones who do evil things.

[From [url=https://dantom.itch.io/harold-and-the-witches]Itch.io[/url]]
